coverage.evidence: reach.py executed per file over all 54 sweep scenarios: 16 files reached, 80 blind (out_reach.txt). Reached files are judged by cpu_share.py (whole-solve channel), mem_confined.py (memory channel, all 54 scenarios, injected, null and top-n arms) and percycle.py (work/traced readings under 4 per-cycle injections). The blind files are covered by D9-s3-02. The card .js is never loaded by a Python gate, so it is blind. C1: mem_confined.py injects a 2x retained ballast. The traced arm detects it on 6/6 probed scenarios and the RSS arm on 0/54. It goes unseen on 48 unprobed scenarios (D9-s3-01). A per-cycle retained regression is unseen everywhere (D9-s3-02).

findings.title: Stress memory channel probes 6 of 54 scenarios: a 2x retained-bytes regression in any of the other 48 passes
findings.claim: With a ballast equal to each scenario's recorded traced peak retained inside HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize (a 2x traced regression), the gate's own thresholds flag 54/54 probe readings, but the memory pass only probes the 6 labels _memory_probe_labels selects, so a 2x confined to any of the other 48 scenarios passes green, while the pass's detection check ('budgets tight enough to see a 2x') reports green on multiples computed over all recorded rows.
findings.mechanism: tests/stress.py's memory pass (check mode) probes MEMORY_TOP_N=6 labels chosen from the committed table (3 by traced_peak_mb, 3 by rss_peak_mb); the other rows of stress_budgets.json are never measured in a gate run. The detection-sizing check computes rss/traced threshold multiples (1.5x) over every recorded row and prints them 'over the 6 scenario(s) this pass probes', so it holds the thresholds to DETECTION_TARGET but never the sampling. Corollary from the null arm: on this box's clean tree 9 of the 48 unprobed rows already read 1.6-2.3x their record (their records are never re-read), so the table's unprobed half is unverified.

findings.instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.optimizer:HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize (ballast retained there, read through stress._run_memory_probe / traced_fail_threshold / rss_attrib_fail_threshold and the gate's _memory_probe_labels exec'd from tests/stress.py)

perturbation.change: --top-n 108 (the gate's STRESS_MEMORY_TOP_N raised past the scenario count, so the pass probes every scenario)

findings.metric_definition: Per sweep scenario: detected = in the gate's memory probe set AND the gate's own traced/RSS thresholds fire on the probe reading with a retained ballast of 1x the recorded traced peak.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every scenario whose memory peak is recorded in tests/stress_budgets.json must be re-measured by a gate run (or the detection check must count only the rows it re-measures), so that a 2x memory regression confined to any recorded scenario fails the gate.
findings.seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D9/s3/mem_confined.py --ballast-factor 1.0  (BLIND line lists every recorded scenario the pass does not probe)

null_control.note: No injection: the 6 probed scenarios read inside 1.5x (no false positive); the injection is what moves the probed set to flagged. 9 unprobed rows read 1.6-2.3x their record clean on this box, so 39 of the 48 blind scenarios are blind to the injection alone.

reproduction_steps: Run the harness with default args: RESULT detected_confined=6, blind_confined=48.
Run with --top-n 108: detected_confined rises to the scenarios flagged.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: tests/stress.py memory pass: probe every recorded scenario in check mode (or rotate a deterministic subset with a per-run budget and make the detection check judge only the probed rows); re-record the memory half on the CI platform after.

findings.title: Stress gate runs no coordinator cycle: 2x solves/cycle, payload, retained growth or lost GIL yields read unchanged
findings.claim: Four injected per-cycle regressions -- the coordinator's solve run twice (2 -> 4 _multi_start_minimize entries per cycle), the published dict doubled (89,220 -> 177,853 JSON bytes), each cycle's dict retained (+~205 kB/cycle), and every optimizer GIL yield removed (394 -> 0 sleeps per cycle) -- leave the stress gate's solver_evals, solver_simulate_steps and solver_calls bit-identical and its traced peak within 0.55% on five sweep scenarios, because build_case executes 0 of coordinator.py's 835 functions and 80 of the 96 D9 universe files at all.
findings.mechanism: tests/stress.py measures only HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize called directly by build_case; it never drives HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._async_update_data, the process-worker submission, _build_data_dict or the event loop. Of D9.md's six metrics only sse_per_gradient (and the per-solve CPU/memory) has a stress channel; solves_per_cycle, gil_hold, loop_thread_work, retained_bytes (per-cycle slope) and payload_bytes have none, and nothing else in the gate budgets them (the owner's 'whether the stress budget should become a real gate' for the cycle).

perturbation.observed_value: solves/cycle 2.00->4.00; payload 89220->177853 B; retained growth 9136->213862 B/cycle; yields/cycle 394->0 (direction to_zero); gate deviations 0.0000 counts, <=0.0055 traced

findings.metric_definition: Per arm: the targeted per-cycle metric on a real coordinator cycle vs the ratio of the gate's build_case readings (evals, simulate steps, calls, traced peak) to the clean arm.
findings.phenomenon_property: Each D9 per-cycle metric (solves per cycle, loop-thread work, GIL hold, retained bytes per cycle, payload bytes) has a gate channel that fails on a 2x regression of it; a metric no channel reads cannot regress green unseen.

reproduction_steps: Run percycle.py: each ARM line shows the per-cycle metric moved; each RESULT <arm>_gate_*_max_dev reads 0.0000 for counts.
Run reach.py: RESULT coordinator_executed=0, files_blind=80 of 96.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: A per-cycle stress lane (tests/): drive N coordinator cycles on the in-process worker, record solves/cycle, payload bytes, retained growth slope and loop-thread time per scenario in a budgets file, and fail at DETECTION_TARGET like the solve channels.

non_findings.claim: No single reached production file holds enough of the solve CPU outside the metered kernels for a file-confined 2x to be an over-DETECTION_TARGET solve regression. Kernels hold a median 0.73, judged per call by kernel_cost_over_verdict. The top non-kernel file is optimizer.py at a median 0.036 (max 0.106), against the 0.414 the sqrt 2 whole-solve median needs. 0 of 16 files trip it, so the gap is by design. Provisional CPU shares, load1 9.5. Perturbation --double optimizer:_fd_rows moved optimizer.py 0.0288 -> 0.0304.
non_findings.value: files_whose_2x_trips_whole_solve=0/16; top median share 0.0363; kernel median share 0.7316

non_findings.claim: On the scenarios it does probe, the memory channel catches an injected 2x traced regression with no false positive. Traced arm 1.95-2.11x against the 1.5x threshold, flagged 6/6. The null arm flags 0/6.
The gate's work-count readings are deterministic on an unchanged tree, so a flat reading under injection is not noise.

leads.what: The clean coordinator's tracemalloc current grows 5-9 kB per cycle over cycles 2-4 (FakeHass, in-process worker, dhw config; percycle.py clean and noyield arms), against B4's 199 B per cycle. Not taken after 200 warm-up cycles, so it needs the retained-bytes harness's slope.
